newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Power wins Saguaro arbitration.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Power wins Saguaro arbitration.

text.p: Nevada Power Co announced Friday a favorable arbitration decision in a more than $2-million proceeding brought against it by Saguaro Power Co.

Saguaro initiated the arbitration in June 1995, seeking to recover electric energy and capacity costs resulting from curtailment of power deliveries during low load conditions on the Nevada Power system.
But the arbitrator found that the utility's actions were proper, according to Nevada Power.
The utility entered into contracts with Saguaro to purchase electricity pursuant to the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
